content_sections.heading: DoP Technical Consultant and Young Professional Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: For both Technical Consultant Grade-I posts, the age must not exceed 40 years as on 31 October 2026. Essential qualification: B.E./B.Tech (Biomedical, Biotechnology, Electronics, Instrumentation engineering) or M. Pharma. Experience: A minimum of 3 years' work experience in Medical Devices Manufacturing, Medical Devices Regulatory Affairs, Medical Device Research and Development, a Medical Device Testing Laboratory and related subject. Sound knowledge or hands-on experience in these areas is also listed: Medical devices manufacturing industry Domestic and global medical devices trade and regulatory issues Latest technologies and trends in medical devices Data analytics in economics/industry Programme management, if any Desirable: M. Tech or equivalent post graduate degree (in Biomedical, Biotechnology, Instrumentation engineering). Essential qualification: Master's/Integrated Degree in M. Pharma/M.Sc. (Pharmacology). Experience: Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in: Pharmaceutical industry Pharmaceutical/Medical Device Regulatory Authority/Govt. Department Relevant consulting or research organizations Trade and market access analysis, or data analytics in economics/industry Desirable: In-depth understanding of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Key Starting Materials (KSMs) and Drug Intermediates (DIs). Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines Good organisational skills with excellent communication, writing and presentation skills Good knowledge and skill in word processing, spreadsheets and presentation software See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: This consultant will provide specialised technical and analytical support on medical devices. The role focuses on regulatory compliance, market analysis, quality standards, manufacturing competitiveness and policy inputs. The duties include: Supporting research on global and domestic policies, industry trends, manufacturing promotion and access to medical devices Assisting with background notes, talking points, briefs, presentations and minutes for meetings, events and conferences Supporting coordination with industry associations and related Departments of the Government of India Providing comprehensive secretarial support, including drafting proposals, handling correspondence, file processing and record-keeping Carrying out other duties entrusted from time to time This consultant will provide technical, regulatory and analytical support for initiatives in the Indian pharmaceutical sector, including policy development, industry competitiveness, trade facilitation, quality compliance and market access. The role requires strong knowledge of India's pharma ecosystem, regulatory frameworks and global pharmaceutical trends. The duties include: Assisting with background notes, briefs and presentations for bilateral and multilateral meetings, trade negotiations and other international engagements Helping to collect and analyse data, especially trade data, and preparing summary notes Supporting research and analytical reports on country profiles related to pharmaceuticals and medical devices, international trade matters, regulations and market access issues Providing comprehensive secretarial support, including drafting proposals, handling correspondence, file processing and record-keeping Carrying out other duties entrusted from time to time

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee for both Technical Consultant Grade-I posts is Nil.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The positions are contractual, and both Technical Consultant Grade-I posts are whole time. A Technical Consultant will not be regarded for any purpose as an employee, official or representative of DoP. The relationship between DoP and a Technical Consultant will not be one of employer and employee, or of principal and agent. Hiring would be governed by the 'Guidelines for engagement of Technical Consultant on contract basis', issued vide F.no. A-41011/01/2022-Estt. (E-21833) dated 03.02.2026 and available on the department's website.

faq.question: Q1. How many Technical Consultant vacancies are there in the Medical Devices Division?
faq.answer: There are 2 whole-time positions for Technical Consultant Grade-I (Medical Devices). The International Cooperation Division has 1 Technical Consultant position.

faq.question: Q2. Can an M. Pharma holder apply for the Medical Devices post?
faq.answer: Yes. M. Pharma is accepted as an alternative to B.E./B.Tech in Biomedical, Biotechnology, Electronics or Instrumentation engineering, along with at least 3 years of work experience in the medical devices field.

faq.question: Q3. Which degree is needed for Technical Consultant Grade-I (Pharmaceuticals)?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Master's/Integrated Degree in M. Pharma/M.Sc. (Pharmacology), with at least 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply by email instead of sending a hard copy?
faq.answer: Yes. Either method is accepted, and email applications go to [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. Can the application be delivered by hand?
faq.answer: Yes. It can be delivered in a sealed cover to the Office of the Under Secretary (E&A) at G-19, Shastri Bhawan, during working hours on a working day.

faq.question: Q6. Will a Technical Consultant be treated as a government employee?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that the consultant will not be regarded for any purpose as an employee, official or representative of DoP.

faq.question: Q7. Which guidelines govern the Technical Consultant engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is governed by the guidelines issued vide F.no. A-41011/01/2022-Estt. (E-21833) dated 3 February 2026. Applicants confirm in the form that they have read them and agree to abide by them.

faq.question: Q8. Do I have to disclose a criminal case in the application?
faq.answer: Yes. Item 10 of the Technical Consultant form asks for details of any past conviction for an offence or any pending criminal case.
